## `i18n`

<a id="entry-i18n"></a>

Load translation catalogs

Load translation dictionaries required by a component.

Starts loading one or more named dictionaries through loadI18n, stores their completion promise in plugin bookkeeping, and reports load errors.

Compose with the existing @tr expressions and locale configuration; file identifies dictionaries rather than a replacement translation engine.

Normal plugin application does not expose the completion promise or wait for these loads. Unplug drops plugin bookkeeping; it does not unload shared dictionaries or change the global locale.

Positional order: `file`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | `arrayOrString` | `common` | Translation catalogs<br>Shorthand |
